raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Follow-up to #59221, which lets `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS` fold GLM-5.3-Flash's shared expert into the AITER fused MoE on gfx950. This PR allows it on gfx942 with 304 CUs (MI300X, MI325X) at TP2, TP4 and TP8, the shapes that ROCm/aiter#5953 tunes. Part of #58409.

## Claims

- On MI325X at TP4, GLM-5.3-Flash at 131K in / 1K out, over two runs at concurrency 2-12:
  - output throughput +2.1% to +8.0%;
  - TPOT 1.2% to 11.4% better;
  - TTFT unchanged within noise, gsm8k unchanged.
- With MTP, the draft model's MoE is fused too, and acceptance is unchanged (68.2% vs 68.0%).
- Nothing changes unless the flag is set; it defaults to off. These keep the separate shared-expert MLP, with the one-time warning #59221 added:
  - other gfx942 parts;
  - other TP sizes;
  - data, prefill-context or expert parallelism.

## Validation

**Unit tests**, on MI325X: `pytest tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py`, with this branch's `glm5next/common/{model,mtp}.py` over `vllm/vllm-openai-rocm:nightly-43b4aaea3e40e20ef53ce2bfecfa1b72060bf2b5`. 100 passed. The gate test now covers:
- gfx950, a 304-CU gfx942, an 80-CU gfx942 and another GPU;
- gfx942 at TP1, TP2, TP4 and TP8.

pre-commit (ruff, mypy 3.12 and the local hooks) is clean.

**End to end** on 4x MI325X, TP4, `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash` FP8, with ROCm/aiter#5953's rows:
- **Image:** a ROCm nightly (vLLM 0.3.1.dev190+g3df4ae153) with #57161, #58008 and local GLM-5.3-Flash performance patches. Every arm uses this image and differs only in the flag.
- **Code:** these runs used #59221 before its gfx950 gate was added; on gfx942 at TP4 that is the same code as this branch.
- **Benchmark:** 131072 in / 1024 out, 20 prompts and 2 warmups per concurrency.
- **Order:** three sweeps back to back on the same GPUs (flag on, off, on), so linear drift over the afternoon cancels in the mean of the two "on" runs.

Percentages are improvements, so lower TPOT and TTFT show as positive:

| conc | tok/s off | tok/s on (run 1 / run 2) | TPOT off (ms) | TPOT on (run 1 / run 2) | mean TTFT off (s) | mean TTFT on (run 1 / run 2) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2 | 111.2 | 117.8 / 117.4 (+5.9% / +5.6%) | 11.11 | 10.20 / 10.22 (+8.2% / +8.0%) | 7.04 | 6.95 / 6.98 (+1.3% / +0.9%) |
| 4 | 137.7 | 148.2 / 148.7 (+7.6% / +8.0%) | 17.39 | 15.45 / 15.41 (+11.2% / +11.4%) | 11.93 | 11.83 / 11.76 (+0.9% / +1.4%) |
| 6 | 146.6 | 151.8 / 151.6 (+3.5% / +3.4%) | 24.32 | 22.32 / 23.28 (+8.2% / +4.3%) | 14.11 | 14.65 / 13.95 (-3.8% / +1.2%) |
| 8 | 157.2 | 162.3 / 163.3 (+3.2% / +3.8%) | 31.16 | 29.15 / 30.28 (+6.5% / +2.8%) | 16.77 | 17.37 / 16.26 (-3.6% / +3.0%) |
| 10 | 165.9 | 170.5 / 169.8 (+2.8% / +2.4%) | 40.12 | 37.99 / 38.96 (+5.3% / +2.9%) | 20.48 | 21.02 / 20.26 (-2.6% / +1.1%) |
| 12 | 167.0 | 170.6 / 170.5 (+2.2% / +2.1%) | 44.83 | 43.24 / 44.27 (+3.5% / +1.2%) | 24.26 | 24.35 / 23.65 (-0.3% / +2.5%) |
| 16 | 168.2 | 173.9 / 160.1 † (+3.4% / -4.8%) | 53.90 | 51.77 / 58.36 † (+4.0% / -8.3%) | 34.95 | 34.76 / 36.43 † (+0.5% / -4.2%) |

† This row of the second run overlapped an unrelated container starting on the same host; the first run shows the undisturbed effect.

- **Failures:** no failed requests.
- **gsm8k strict-match** (5-shot, chat completions, all 1319 questions; standard error ±0.0045): 0.9719 with the flag off, 0.9689 and 0.9742 with it on.
- **Path check** with `AITER_LOG_TUNED_CONFIG=1`: every fused-MoE lookup is `(E=289, topk=9)` with the flag on and `(E=288, topk=8)` with it off.

MTP (k=5), flag off vs on:

| | flag off | flag on |
|---|---|---|
| gsm8k strict-match / flexible-extract | 0.9750 / 0.9742 | 0.9742 / 0.9742 |
| draft acceptance rate | 67.96% | 68.24% |
| mean acceptance length (max 6) | 4.40 | 4.41 |
| per-position acceptance | 0.941 / 0.827 / 0.681 / 0.540 / 0.409 | 0.943 / 0.832 / 0.685 / 0.542 / 0.410 |

To reproduce:

```bash
# Flag off: VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=0
# MTP runs add: --speculative-config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":5}'
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE=1 AITER_LOG_TUNED_CONFIG=1 \
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1 \
vllm serve zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash --tensor-parallel-size 4 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 --max-model-len 262144 \
  --no-enable-prefix-caching --trust-remote-code \
  --compilation-config '{"custom_ops": ["all"]}'

vllm bench serve --dataset-name random --random-input-len 131072 \
  --random-output-len 1024 --num-prompts 20 --num-warmups 2 \
  --max-concurrency {2,4,6,8,10,12,16}
```

## Details

- **Gate structure.** `_fused_shared_experts_tuned()` keeps #59221's structure. gfx950 allows TP4 and TP8 (ROCm/aiter#5735), and 304-CU gfx942 allows TP2, TP4 and TP8 (ROCm/aiter#5953). The data, prefill-context and expert-parallel checks are unchanged.
- **Why the CU check.** #5953's rows are keyed to 304 CUs, so other gfx942 parts (MI308X, MI300A) would miss them and run the fused shape untuned. On MI325X an untuned call is 4289 µs, against 3033 µs tuned, for one 16K-token MoE call.
- **TP coverage.** Only TP4 was measured end to end. TP2 and TP8 rely on #5953's rows, which were tuned and checked for correctness at those sizes in #5953.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans).
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

inline_comments.body: The test asserts an exact, full-string match on the warning “reason” text. This makes the test brittle to harmless copy edits (including improvements like adding CU counts per the new gating). Prefer asserting stable substrings / structured conditions (e.g., that the reason contains “304-CU gfx942” or indicates “untuned GPU”) rather than an exact message, so future improvements to the warning don’t require updating many tests.
